definitions.gloss: tragedy, tragic event, disaster, horrific incident
definitions.explanation: A terrible event involving suffering, destruction, or death. Stronger and more dramatic than simply a sad event — implies horror and shock.

examples.japanese: {惨劇|さんげき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{惨劇|さんげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}して→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We must never repeat this tragedy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{惨劇|さんげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐ→語り継ぐ：22312_kataritsugu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to pass on accounts of the tragedies of war.

notes:
USAGE:
A dramatic, literary word. Common in news reporting, historical accounts, and fiction. Not the same as ⟦{悲劇|ひげき}→悲劇：03577_higeki⟧ (tragedy in the theatrical sense or a sad event) — {惨劇|さんげき} implies gruesome or horrifying circumstances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {惨劇|さんげき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a tragedy occurs
- {惨劇|さんげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat a tragedy
- {惨劇|さんげき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: scene of a tragedy
- {惨劇|さんげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐ→語り継ぐ：22312_kataritsugu⟧: to pass on the story of a tragedy
